title: Funding-conditioned shorts + liquidity/depth guard; rotation and wallet-flow ideas retained as secondary research tracks
hypothesis: For existing futures SHORT candidates, requiring positive or improving side-aligned funding together with negative momentum and acceptable depth/spread may improve net risk-adjusted results by avoiding crowded short squeezes and compensating carry, while preserving most trade frequency. Separately, cost-aware cross-sectional rotation and provenance-scored wallet-cluster flow may add value but require broader implementation/validation.
mechanism: Several public X posts repeat extraordinary unverified PnL claims, so their results are not evidence. The reusable mechanism is narrower: positive funding means longs pay shorts; combine carry direction with already-negative momentum and sufficient depth/liquidity so the short thesis is not based on funding alone. Posts also repeatedly emphasize rejecting low-liquidity setups, cross-symbol rotation without position attachment, and multi-wallet clustering/provenance. Official Bitquery docs confirm read-only multi-chain wallet/trade/flow data is available through its MCP with a free tier; open-source Polymarket datasets/backtesting tooling also exist. Treat these as research inputs, not live signals.
exact_rule_or_model_spec: PAPER-ONLY SHORT_FUNDING_DEPTH_GUARD_V1. On an existing baseline SHORT candidate only, test a gate requiring side-aligned funding to be favorable to the short (positive underlying funding / shorts receive carry under the exchange convention), side-aligned short momentum to remain supportive, and spread/depth to be within historically acceptable cost bands. Do not create a SHORT from funding alone, do not alter LONG logic, and do not increase leverage or notional. Compare baseline vs funding-only vs momentum-only vs funding×momentum vs funding×momentum×depth/spread. Preserve the baseline trade when the guard is unavailable. Secondary non-production research: cost-aware cross-sectional rotation where a new symbol must exceed the current position's expected net edge by switching cost+safety margin; wallet-cluster/provenance signals remain NEEDS_IMPLEMENTATION until point-in-time data and anti-copycat leakage controls exist.
required_data: Point-in-time funding and settled funding per symbol with exchange convention normalized
L2 spread/depth and modeled entry/exit slippage
Baseline candidate side/score/notional and realized paper outcome
Optional wallet-flow cluster/provenance data for later implementation
Optional Polymarket order-book/history datasets for separate prediction-market research
transaction_cost_implications: A funding filter can reduce trade count and opportunity capture; positive carry is small relative to adverse price movement. Evaluate actual fees, slippage, funding timing, spread/depth deterioration, missed-trade opportunity cost and 1.5x/2x execution-cost stress. Rotation must pay the full switching cost before replacing a position.
expected_benefit: Potentially improve short-side profit factor and drawdown by avoiding crowded or illiquid shorts while preserving useful frequency. Secondary rotation/wallet-flow tracks could improve symbol selection if validated.
risks: The social-media profit figures are extraordinary and unverified, many posts contain affiliate/referral links, and survivorship/selection bias is likely. Positive funding can precede both continuation and violent squeezes. Wallet-following can be stale, manipulated, or non-causal. Prediction-market latency claims may disappear after realistic latency and fees.
falsification_criteria: Reject the short funding/depth guard if locked chronological OOS and future-only paper tests do not improve net PnL/PF/max drawdown versus baseline, if retention falls below 85%, if results vanish under 1.5x costs, or if improvements are concentrated in one regime/cluster. Reject rotation if incremental net edge does not exceed measured switching costs. Reject wallet signals if point-in-time provenance does not add value over price/flow controls.
validation_plan: Use existing as-of feature dataset only. Chronological train/validation/test with frozen thresholds, then a fresh future-only shadow. Run ablations: baseline, funding-only, momentum-only, funding×momentum, depth/spread-only, full interaction. Report net PnL, PF, max DD, retention, trade count, side-specific results and cost sensitivity. Wallet and Polymarket extensions require separate datasets and must not be mixed into the current feature test until timestamps/provenance are verified.
minimum_sample: At least 200 SHORT baseline decisions with >=50 funding-favorable states across multiple regimes for offline screening, then >=60 new future-covered trades for any frozen candidate; extend if regime concentration is high.
contradictions: Social posts report extreme returns without independently verifiable complete trade ledgers.
The same marketing/referral ecosystems recur across several posts, increasing promotional-bias risk.
Funding-positive shorts may earn carry but can still be exposed to squeeze risk; direction must come from independent price/flow evidence.
invalidation_triggers: Funding normalization or exchange convention cannot be verified as-of.
Depth/spread data are stale or unavailable.
Locked OOS or prospective results underperform baseline after costs.
Trade retention or capital utilization degrades materially.
